page_title: HAV 0-1 NAN | Le Havre v Nantes 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Kader Bamba (Nantes) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+3' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.

90+2' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Kader Bamba (Nantes) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Arthur Desmas just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
90+1' Booking. Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) receives a caution from the referee.
90+1' The linesman makes the right call and Nantes will have a corner.
90' Matthis Abline comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marcus Coco (Nantes).
89' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
88' Here comes a substitution. Daler Kuzyaev is given a rest as he is replaced by Simon Ebonog (Le Havre).
88' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) replacing Andre Ayew.
88' Substitution. Emmanuel Sabbi did his best and is replaced by Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre).
86' The referee points to the corner flag and Nantes will take a corner.
85' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
83' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem ignores the protests.
83' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Kelvin Amian (Nantes), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
79' Here is a change. Samuel Moutoussamy is going off and Antoine Kombouare gives the last tactical orders to Douglas Augusto (Nantes).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florent Mollet leaves the pitch and Kader Bamba (Nantes) comes on.
76' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
76' A lofted cross from Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
74' Nantes force their opponents to concede a corner.
72' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) will take a corner kick.
71' Substitution. Yassine Kechta walks off the pitch and Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
70' Matthis Abline (Nantes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for an infringement.
69' Matthis Abline (Nantes) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
68' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
66' Today's match ends for Mostafa Mohamed who will be replaced by Benie Traore (Nantes).
66' A yellow card for a tackle by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes). Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
65' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Alban Lafont comes off his line to gather the ball.
64' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

61' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Alban Lafont, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
60' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alban Lafont intercepts the ball.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
59' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Le Havre.
58' Matthis Abline (Nantes) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
55' Florent Mollet (Nantes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem signals.
54' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
53' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
49' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
48' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' A substitution has been made. Loic Nego is replaced by Josue Casimir (Le Havre).
46' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' Loic Nego (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Nantes, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
43' Florent Mollet (Nantes) steps up to send the ball in.
43' Matthis Abline (Nantes) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
41' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) serves up a nice cross, but Alban Lafont punches the ball away.
40' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) brought his opponent down.
37' The corner from Florent Mollet (Nantes) is hurriedly cleared.
36' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

36' Florent Mollet (Nantes) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the bottom right corner, but Arthur Desmas answers with a superb save to deny him. Nantes have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' The Nantes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
30' The ball goes out for a corner. Le Havre can continue in their attacking effort.
28' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Florent Mollet (Nantes) is flagged for offside.
26' Loic Nego (Le Havre) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
23' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Kelvin Amian (Nantes). Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Le Havre.
21' Florent Mollet (Nantes) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

20' Matthis Abline (Nantes) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Arthur Desmas is equal to the effort and makes a good save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.

19' The opposition back off Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Alban Lafont denies him with the save.
16' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) picks up a yellow card.
16' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alban Lafont reads it well and gathers the ball.
15' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Corner kick. Le Havre will have an opportunity.
14' Matthis Abline (Nantes) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

11' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Alban Lafont displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
10' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
10' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
8' Good clearance! Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
6' Matthis Abline (Nantes) picks up a long through ball, but Arthur Desmas deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
3' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) makes a strong challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
